The USB memory drive is missing,
blank, or is not installed correctly.

 Ensure the USB memory drive is
installed correctly in one of the
slots available.
 If the tabulator is still unable to
detect the card, contact ES&S for
another USB memory drive.

The upper right-hand
corner display shows a
red X through the power
icon.

The tabulator is not plugged into
the AC power cord, or the wall
outlet is defective.

 Check that the power cord is
plugged in securely to the outlet
and to the machine.
 Test all outlets.
 Check the tabulator power cord for
damage. Replace the cord if
damaged.

What do I use to clean
the exterior of the
tabulator including the
touch screen?

 The tabulator touch screen can be
cleaned with isopropyl alcohol
wipes or isopropyl alcohol on a
soft cloth.

Where do I insert the
ExpressVote® ballot card
into the tabulator?

The paper guide mounts into the
input tray on the front cover.
The paper guide is a solid unit that
accommodates the 8.5” ballots
below the guide and 4.26” vote
summary cards in the slot above.

 The touch screen animation shows
election judges where to insert the
paper ballot or ExpressVote® ballot
card into the tabulator.
 The animation alternates between
the paper ballot and ExpressVote®
ballot card screens.
